message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
    push:
        branches: [ main ]
    pull_request:
        branches: [ main ]
    workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
    coverage:
        name: "Code coverage"
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - name: "Checkout sources"
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                  submodules: recursive

            - name: "Set up Pixi"
              uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.8.10
              with:
                  pixi-version: v0.72.2
                  cache: true

            - name: "Run coverage tests"
              run: |
                  pixi run coverage

            - name: "Upload coverage results"
              env:
                  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
              run: |
                  pixi run coveralls

    lint:
        name: "Code style"
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - name: "Checkout sources"
              uses: actions/checkout@v4

            - name: "Set up Pixi"
              uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.8.10
              with:
                  pixi-version: v0.72.2
                  cache: true

            - name: "Check code format"
              run: |
                  pixi run lint

    test:
        name: "Test with ${{ matrix.pyenv }} on ${{ matrix.os }}"
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        strategy:
            matrix:
                os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
                pyenv: [py310, py311, py312, py313, py314]
        steps:
            - name: "Checkout sources"
              uses: actions/checkout@v4

            - name: "Set up Pixi"
              uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.8.10
              with:
                  pixi-version: v0.72.2
                  environments: test-${{ matrix.pyenv }}
                  cache: true

            - name: "Run unit tests"
              run: |
                  pixi run -e test-${{ matrix.pyenv }} test

    ci_success:
        name: "CI success"
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        needs: [coverage, lint, test]
        steps:
            - run: echo "CI workflow completed successfully"",
  "rationale": "The workflow already caches Pixi environments in every job, so dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is covered and an equivalent cache already exists. A suitable, safe optimization is canceling superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE): this is CI-only work on push/pull_request to main, not release or deployment, and each branch/PR gets its own concurrency group so distinct branches are isolated. Adding a workflow-level concurrency group with cancel-in-progress stops older in-progress runs when a newer revision of the same branch/PR arrives, reducing duplicate VM work while preserving all build and test coverage for the latest revision. The ci_success gate and all required checks still run to completion on the newest run. No permissions, secrets, or deployment steps are changed.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
